behalf of the State respondent.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that there is only one case against the petitioner under Sections 323, 325, 354, 504, 506 IPC.

sentences.text: It is essential that before seeking personal bond from any person, satisfaction is to be recorded by the Magistrate in order to ensure that the person comes within the ambit of Section 110(a) to (g).
It is also necessary that the substance of the information and the nature of the allegations levelled are to be reflected in show cause notice under Section 110/111 Cr.P.C.
The present notice has been issued without disclosing substance of the allegations and the information.
No basis or ground has been disclosed to show, why the noticee is dangerous or hazardous for the society.
Vague and ambiguous information does not satisfy the requirement of the said Section.

In view of the above, the impugned notice dated 02.03.2020 issued by the opposite party no. 2-Sub Divisional Magistrate, Tehsil Kadipur, District Sultanpur and the order passed by Sessions Judge,
Sultanpur in Criminal Revision No. 124 of 2020 (Kedar Nath Versus State of U.P.) are hereby quashed.

This petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the notice dated 02.03.2020 under
Section 111 Cr.P.C. issued by opposite party no. 2 and order dated 10.12.2020 passed by Sessions
Judge, Sultanpur.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
It is essential that before seeking personal bond from any person, satisfaction is to be recorded by the Magistrate in order to ensure that the person comes within the ambit of Section 110(a) to (g).
It is also necessary that the substance of the information and the nature of the allegations levelled are to be reflected in show cause notice under Section 110/111 Cr.P.C.
The present notice has been issued without disclosing substance of the allegations and the information.
No basis or ground has been disclosed to show, why the noticee is dangerous or hazardous for the society.
Vague and ambiguous information does not satisfy the requirement of the said Section.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the above, the impugned notice dated 02.03.2020 issued by the opposite party no. 2-Sub Divisional Magistrate, Tehsil Kadipur, District Sultanpur and the order passed by Sessions Judge,
Sultanpur in Criminal Revision No. 124 of 2020 (Kedar Nath Versus State of U.P.) are hereby quashed.
The petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is accordingly allowed.
